stem: After a soundbar and wall-mount bundle offer started, Voltmarkt's webshop UPT rose from 1.8 to 2.1 while its AOV stayed the same. Which statement must be true?

options.text: Each unit sold brought in less net revenue on average than before
Each unit sold brought in more net revenue on average than before
The webshop converted a larger share of its sessions than before
Total webshop net revenue rose by the same share as UPT did
